properties.Notes: The Maximum Density For This Overlay Is 1 Lot Per 25 Acres With A Minimum Lot Size Of 5 Acres. All Proposals Are Reviewed By The Vermont Fish And Wildlife Department to Ensure Building Does not Impact The Deer Wintering Habitat Or The Wildlife Travel Corridor.

Uses Allowed As A Permitted Or Conditional Use In The Underlying Zoning District Require The Approval Of The Planning Commission In This Overlay Except Agriculture/Forestry And Small Accessory Structures Or Additions to Existing Structures.
